tbesh_html:
1) to be or grow wide, be or grow large
1a) (Qal) to be widened, be enlarged
1b) (Niphal) broad or roomy pasture (participle)
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to make large
1c2) to enlarge

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.
